---
name: bro
description: Restate the last message in plain human language, with no jargon.
disable-model-invocation: true
---

Restate your last message. If the user passed words after the slash, restate those instead. Stop using jargon and speak coherently. State it more simply and concisely, like one human talking to another.

Do not add claims that were not in the source. Do not read `.env` or ask for a token.
